_comment: Observability settings. LAW 3: verbatim content never enters git.
Capture writes raw hook payloads (which DO contain prompts, file contents and tool
output) to RECORD_ROOT/spool - outside the repo, outside git, write-denied to every
agent identity. Sealing copies events into segments through seal_allowlist, an
ALLOWLIST: an unknown field is dropped by default, so a new secret-bearing field can
never leak by omission. A denylist would fail silently the day the payload grows.
Raw is KEPT FOREVER by default (it is the agent's ground truth for analysing its own
history); sealed raw is gzip-compacted instead of deleted. retention_days exists as an
off-by-default knob for anyone who wants expiry.
Transcript ingest reads ~/.claude/projects/<slug>*/**/*.jsonl READ-ONLY for token
metadata. It must rglob and prefix-match: subagent transcripts live in nested
<session>/subagents/ directories and git worktrees get their own project slug -
in the source system 502 of 515 transcript files were invisible to a top-level glob.
Metadata only: message text is never copied into segments.
The ONE sanctioned agent pathway over raw: the structured-output analysis engine.
One protocol, OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions, covers OpenRouter, Ollama (/v1),
OpenAI, vLLM and LM Studio. Chunks are sent in parallel; every reply is validated
against a JSON schema mechanically - nothing is analyzed by Claude.
base_url: e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 (key at openrouter.ai/keys),
https://api.openai.com/v1 (platform.openai.com), or http://localhost:11434/v1 for
Ollama (no key). The API key comes from the ENVIRONMENT ONLY - this file is committed:
export ANALYZE_API_KEY=sk-...  (OPENROUTER_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY also honored).
Products land in RECORD_ROOT/analysis/; `obsctl story` folds their labels into the
story feed's analysis lane by plain-code aggregation. Unconfigured degrades to a
guided no-op: nothing else in the system depends on this feature existing.
